items: A quota bump can hide a real retention problem, so when a mailbox is 'low on space' I like to know what is filling it before I just add headroom.
Round-number quota targets that arrive without a stated capacity policy make me want the size signed off before it lands.
Support mailboxes grow fast at peak; I would rather confirm the busy-season ceiling with the owner than guess at 3 GB.
I run the support team's seasonal capacity refresh, and bringing support-leads up to the busy-season size is a step I am cleared to do without separate approval.
Our capacity standard puts the support-leads mailbox at 3 GB for the busy season; this request just applies the agreed size.
Raising support-leads to the published busy-season ceiling is routine pre-cleared capacity work on my side.
